info.description: REST API for Blexchat — social commerce DM and comment automation platform supporting Instagram, WhatsApp, TikTok, and Messenger.

- A text not yet translated is served in English, and `meta.fallback` is then `true`.

get.summary: Start signing up or in with Google
get.description:
Send the visitor to `url`. Google returns them, with `code` and `state` in the query, to the redirect URI this server is set to:

- **Frontend** (default, `FRONTEND_URL/verify/confirm`): that page posts both to **POST /api/v1/auth/google** within 15 minutes. If Google returns `error` instead, show "Google sign-in didn’t finish".
- **This API** (`GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI=…/api/v1/auth/google/callback`, for testing without the frontend): Google lands on **GET /api/v1/auth/google/callback**, which signs in and shows the token as JSON.

post.summary: Finish signing up or in with Google
post.description: Creates the account on first use with the Google email and name. Same answer as the email link: `is_new_user` decides onboarding or the app.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the texts in the response, and of the email where one is sent. Takes precedence over Accept-Language. Defaults to en.

code.description: The `code` query value Google sent back

state.description: The `state` query value Google sent back

422.description: Missing fields, a stale `state` (validation error), or `google_failed`: Google refused the code or the email is not verified

get.summary: Google’s return to this API (testing without the frontend)
get.description: Used only when GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI points here. Google opens this URL in the browser with `code` and `state`; the answer is the same as POST /api/v1/auth/google, shown as JSON. Copy `access_token` into Authorize to try the signed-in endpoints.

post.summary: Email a sign-in link (sign up and sign in)
post.description:
Sign-up and sign-in are passwordless: this emails a link to the address, whether or not it has an account yet.
The link opens `FRONTEND_URL/verify/confirm?token=…` (with `&mode=signin` when signing in); that page posts the token to **POST /api/v1/auth/email-link/verify**.

- A link works **once, for 15 minutes**.
- Another link to the same address can be sent after **59 seconds** (`resend_after`); earlier, the answer is 429 `resend_too_soon` with `retry_after`.
- After 5 links in 15 minutes the answer is 429 `too_many_attempts` ("Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.").
- `mode` only changes the email's wording: `signup` (default) "Confirm your email", `signin` "Your sign-in link".

**Development servers only:** with `AUTH_EXPOSE_LOGIN_LINKS=true` the response also carries `dev_link` and `dev_token`, so the flow can be tested without an inbox. Never present in production.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the texts in the response, and of the email where one is sent. Takes precedence over Accept-Language. Defaults to en.

resend_after.description: Seconds before another link can be sent

dev_link.description: Development servers only: the emailed link

dev_token.description: Development servers only: the token to post to /email-link/verify

post.summary: Sign in with the token from the emailed link
post.description:
Called by the frontend's verify page ("One more step") with the `token` from its URL.
Creates the account on first use, and returns the bearer token for every later request (`Authorization: Bearer …`).

- `is_new_user: true` → a new account: go to onboarding ("Account created").
- `is_new_user: false` → a returning user: go to the app ("Welcome back").
- 410 `link_expired` → the link was used already, is past its 15 minutes, or is unknown. `data.email` (when known) is the address to offer "Send a new link" to.

post.summary: Open the payment page for a plan ("Continue To Payment")
post.description:
Returns a payment session; send the browser to its `url`. Which page that is depends on the server's
`PAYMENT_DRIVER`, and the frontend handles both the same way.

**Fake driver (`PAYMENT_DRIVER=fake`: the development server and local).** `url` is a test page on this
API (`/payments/fake/{id}?expires=…&signature=…`) showing the plan, the billing period, the coupon and
the total, with two buttons and no card:

| Button | Effect | Browser goes to |
|---|---|---|
| Pay (test) | The plan is paid and in place at once | `FRONTEND_URL/app?checkout=success&session_id={id}` |
| Decline | Nothing is charged; the session stays `open` | `FRONTEND_URL/app?checkout=cancelled` |

Pay on a session that has expired also goes to `checkout=cancelled`. Add `&lang=ar` to `url` for the
Arabic page. The page answers 403 when its link is altered or older than 24 hours, and 404 wherever
the fake driver is off.

**Stripe (`PAYMENT_DRIVER=stripe`: production).** `url` is the Stripe-hosted page; it sends the browser
to the same two addresses. The plan is in place once Stripe reports the payment, a few seconds later.

**On `checkout=success`:** read `session_id` from the address and call
GET /api/v1/checkout/session/{session_id}. `status: complete` means paid, and `subscription` holds the
plan; poll every few seconds while it is `open`. **On `checkout=cancelled`:** show the plan unchanged;
the visitor may start again.

A `coupon` (checked with POST /api/v1/coupons/check) comes off the first payment. The plan renews every
month or year until cancelled. Free trials never come here: they take no card (POST /api/v1/onboarding/plan).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the error messages. Takes precedence over Accept-Language. Defaults to en.

409.description: `plan_already_paid`: this plan and billing period are already paid by card

422.description: A coupon that does not apply (CouponError), or an unknown or free plan or billing period (ValidationError)

429.description: Too many attempts; try again in a minute

503.description: `payments_unavailable`: no Stripe key is set on this server (or the fake driver is refused in production)

get.description: For `FRONTEND_URL/app?checkout=success&session_id={id}`: pass `session_id` from that address. `complete` means paid and `subscription` holds the plan. On the fake driver it is `complete` straight after "Pay (test)"; on Stripe it may still be `open` for a few seconds (this asks Stripe), so poll every few seconds while `status` is `open`. After "Decline" it stays `open`.

this only checks the code and prices the plan with it. Send the code on to

Every homepage section in display order, the live-demo reply rules, and the top bar and footer every marketing page shares. No authentication.

**Language**
- Send `?lang=ar` for Arabic or `?lang=en` for English.
- Without `lang`, the `Accept-Language` header is used (`ar`, `ar-SA`, `en-US`…).

- Any text not yet translated is served in English, field by field, and `meta.fallback` is then `true`.

post.summary: Finish connecting an Instagram professional account
post.description:
Post what Instagram sent back to the redirect page. Exchanges the code for a long-lived token, saves the account and subscribes it to comments and messages.

- **Reconnect** (W06 `reconnect`): signing in again to an account this owner already has refreshes its token and makes it `active`, so its paused automations run again. `meta.reconnected` is true.
- **`access_denied`** (422): Instagram sent `error` instead of `code`: the owner cancelled or refused (W06 `denied`).
- **`account_ineligible`** (422): Instagram says the account is not a professional one (W06 `ineligible`).
- **`account_taken`** (409): another workspace already connected this account (W06 `taken`). Send `access_request_token` for "Request access".

post.summary: Receive Stripe payment events
post.description:
Stripe calls this; requests are authenticated by the `Stripe-Signature` header (HMAC-SHA256 with
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, at most 5 minutes old), not a user. Events handled:

- `checkout.session.completed`: the plan paid for is put in place.
- `invoice.paid`: a renewal; the paid period moves on.
- `customer.subscription.deleted`: the card plan ended; the account is on Free again.
- `checkout.session.expired`: the payment page closed unpaid.

Stripe may send an event more than once; handling it again changes nothing. Other events are acknowledged and ignored.

post.summary: Choose a plan (W09)
post.description:
- **Free** ("Continue with Free"): active at once.
- **A plan with `trial_days`** ("Start free trial" in the checkout): a trial starts and no card is taken. It does not convert: when it ends the account is on Free again. One trial per account.
- **Any other paid plan**, and the trial plan once the account has had its trial: 202 with a Stripe payment page
  (`data.url`, as POST /api/v1/checkout/session). The plan changes once it is paid. Without a Stripe key on the
  server: 402 `payment_required` (409 `trial_used` for the trial plan) instead.

Choosing again replaces the current plan. Choosing Free or a trial stops the card payments of a plan paid by card.

parameters.description: Language of the texts and error messages in the response. Takes precedence over Accept-Language. Defaults to en.

202.description: A paid plan: send the browser to `data.url` to pay

402.description: `payment_required`: a paid plan, and no Stripe key on this server

409.description: `trial_used`: this account already had its free trial, and no Stripe key on this server

post.summary: Change the plan or the billing period
post.description:
The same rules as POST /api/v1/onboarding/plan:
- **Free**: active at once, ending any trial.
- **A plan with `trial_days`**: its trial starts, once per account (409 `trial_used` after). Picking the plan being tried again keeps the trial's clock.
- **Any other paid plan**, and the trial plan after the trial: 202 with a Stripe payment page (`data.url`); the plan
  changes once it is paid. Without a Stripe key on the server: 402 `payment_required` (409 `trial_used`).
- Moving off a plan paid by card to Free or a trial stops its card payments.

Send `plan`, `billing` or both; what is left out stays as it is. `billing` alone needs a plan chosen already.

parameters.description: Language of the texts and error messages in the response. Takes precedence over Accept-Language. Defaults to en.

402.description: `payment_required`: a paid plan, and no Stripe key on this server

409.description: `trial_used`: this account already had its free trial, and no Stripe key on this server

422.description: Unknown plan or billing period, or neither sent

delete.description: Free at once, ending any trial and stopping any card payments; the billing period stays. A trial used stays used.
